# Desire essay outline

Working outline for the long essay on desire. The spine so far: we rarely want things directly; wanting is learned, borrowed and renewed.

## Sections

1. Borrowed wants: start from [[Mimetic desire]] and the triangle of subject, model and object.
2. The gap: [[Desire as lack]] against [[Desire as production]].
3. The treadmill: why satisfaction does not accumulate, see [[Hedonic treadmill]].
4. The market for wanting: [[Advertising and manufactured wants]] and [[Positional goods]].
